families.title: Milne’s rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization.
The full BSD formula from low Selmer corank.

families.title: The quasi-Riemann hypothesis.
Hilbert’s tenth problem over ℚ.
families.description_excerpt: **004. Hilbert’s tenth problem over ℚ.** Proves that no algorithm decides whether an integer-coefficient polynomial in an arbitrary number of variables has a rational zero, resolving Hilbert's tenth problem over ℚ negatively.

families.title: Irrationality of Catalan’s constant.
Goldfeld’s conjecture: densities and mean analytic rank.
families.description_excerpt: **006. Goldfeld’s conjecture: densities and mean analytic rank.** Proves Goldfeld's conjecture for quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over ℚ: analytic ranks zero and one each have density 1/2, and the mean analytic rank tends to 1/2. Both statements order signed squarefree twist parameters by absolute value.

families.description_excerpt: We prove the ordinary two-point Chowla conjecture. families.title: The Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture: the rational Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra is freely generated by one element in every odd weight at least three, with the corresponding isomorphism after weight completion.

families.title: Function-field reconstruction from Milnor K-theory and Galois data.
Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two.

Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two.** Every continuous odd absolutely irreducible two-dimensional 2-adic representation of $`G_{\mathbb Q}`$ unramified outside finitely many primes occurs in a completed Hecke algebra at some odd tame level. families.title: Prime-factor statistics of $`p-1`$.
Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers.
Ostmann’s inverse Goldbach conjecture.
Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan.

families.description_excerpt: We prove the packet form of the higher-dimensional Duke equidistribution problem for totally real fields of any fixed prime degree at least five, allowing arbitrary local homothety types of full lattices. families.title: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold.
families.description_excerpt: **016. Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold.** Proves the abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$: every irreducible subvariety has finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties relative to its smallest containing torsion coset. families.title: The irrationality exponent of π is 2.
The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global fields.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the Margulis–Platonov conjecture over every global function field, including characteristic two. For an absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic group, every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of its rational points is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup of the finite product of its anisotropic local groups.

families.title: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences.
Squarefree quartics and power-free polynomial values.
A quadratic bound for Jacobsthal’s function.
The weak inhomogeneous Duffin–Schaeffer conjecture.
Patterson's first moment for cubic Gauss sums.
families.description_excerpt: We prove Patterson's first-moment conjecture for normalized cubic Gauss sums over all primary Eisenstein primes, unconditionally. The sharp-cutoff main term is $`(6/5)c_*X^{5/6}/\log X`$, where $`c_*=(2\pi)^{2/3}/(3\Gamma(2/3))`$. families.title: An asymptotic formula for the number of totients.
Short Egyptian fractions.
Positive lower density of large prime gaps.
Potential integral density on curve character varieties.
Uniformly bounded components of Gaussian-prime graphs.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the Gaussian moat conjecture: no infinite walk through distinct Gaussian primes can have bounded steps. families.title: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base.
Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields.
families.description_excerpt: **030. Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields.** Proves the modularity conjecture for elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields: every elliptic curve over every imaginary quadratic field is modular, with matching local parameters at every place.

families.title: Uchida’s conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups.
families.description_excerpt: **031. Uchida’s conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups.** Proves Uchida's conjecture: every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of possibly infinite solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields comes from a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction. families.title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties.
families.description_excerpt: **032. The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties.** Proves the rational Hodge conjecture for every complex CM abelian variety, in every dimension and codimension. families.title: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity.
families.description_excerpt: We prove Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for rational simple normal crossing boundaries on compact manifolds in Fujiki class $`\mathcal C`$, including coefficient one. Ordinary and logarithmic subadditivity follow.

families.title: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity.
families.description_excerpt: **034. Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity.** Using logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity, proves log abundance in every dimension for normal compact Kähler log canonical pairs with effective rational boundary: an analytically nef ℚ-Cartier adjoint is semiample. families.title: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one.
Numerical semiampleness and generalized minimal models.
families.description_excerpt: We resolve the existence form of the minimal-model conjecture for projective generalized log canonical ℚ-pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero. families.title: The ordinary-double-point volume gap.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that every singular complex algebraic klt fourfold germ with zero boundary has normalized volume at most 162, with equality precisely for an analytic ordinary double point. This resolves the ordinary-double-point volume-gap conjecture in dimension four.

families.title: Fujita’s freeness conjecture.
Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants.
Bloch’s conjecture for complex surfaces.
families.description_excerpt: We prove Bloch's conjecture for smooth connected projective complex surfaces with $`p_g=0`$: the Albanese homomorphism on integral degree-zero zero-cycles is an isomorphism.

families.title: Hyperkähler SYZ and projective-space bases.
families.description_excerpt: **041. Hyperkähler SYZ and projective-space bases.** Proves the strong hyperkähler SYZ conjecture: every holomorphic line bundle with nonzero nef isotropic first Chern class on a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold is semiample. families.title: Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII.
families.description_excerpt: **042. Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII.** Proves that every complex K3 surface is Oka, including nonprojective surfaces. families.title: P = W for fixed-determinant SLn moduli spaces.
The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: **044. The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture.** Proves the equivariant cohomological Hikita correspondence for every finite quiver, including loops and multiple arrows, with arbitrary dimension and framing vectors and commuting flavor torus. families.title: Shafarevich counterexamples in dimension two and with large fundamental group.
families.description_excerpt: **046. families.title: Zariski cancellation and affine fibrations over the complex numbers.
A characteristic-zero counterexample to Lipman–Zariski.
families.description_excerpt: **048. A characteristic-zero counterexample to Lipman–Zariski.** Constructs a singular normal affine complex surface with free rank-two tangent sheaf, disproving the characteristic-zero Lipman–Zariski conjecture.

families.title: A stable-coordinate counterexample in four variables.
families.description_excerpt: We construct an explicit degree-five polynomial over $`\mathbf C`$ that is not a coordinate in four variables but becomes one after adjoining a single variable. families.title: A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture.
Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: **051. Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture.** Every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension with no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is therefore projective. This proves Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler setting.

families.title: Tangent splittings and product decompositions.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the two-summand form of Beauville's compatible splitting conjecture. If the tangent bundle of a compact connected Kähler manifold decomposes into two integrable holomorphic subbundles of positive rank, then its ordinary universal cover admits a product decomposition whose factor tangent bundles are the lifted specified summands.

families.title: A counterexample to Pixton completeness in Chow.
families.description_excerpt: **053. A counterexample to Pixton completeness in Chow.** Constructs a tautological relation on a moduli space of stable pointed curves that vanishes in rational Chow, hence in rational cohomology, but lies outside Pixton's original relation span. This disproves the Chow and rational-cohomological forms of his original completeness conjecture.

families.title: Irrational cubic fourfolds with Hodge-theoretic and categorical K3 associations.
families.description_excerpt: **054. Irrational cubic fourfolds with Hodge-theoretic and categorical K3 associations.** For every sufficiently large admissible Hassett discriminant, a very general smooth complex cubic fourfold is irrational despite having both an untwisted geometric K3 category and an integral Hodge-theoretic K3 association. families.title: Gepner symmetry and large-volume stability on threefolds.
families.description_excerpt: **055. Gepner symmetry and large-volume stability on threefolds.** Proves Toda's Gepner conjecture for every smooth complex quintic threefold, constructing a numerical Bridgeland stability condition with the prescribed phase shift 2/5. families.title: Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs.
families.description_excerpt: **056. Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs.** Proves termination of every existing generalized log canonical flip sequence on globally Weil ℚ-factorial compact Kähler fourfolds, with rational boundary, fixed rational analytically nef b-data, and projective small flip diagrams with the prescribed ample signs. families.title: Fundamental groups of special complex varieties and root orbifolds.
families.description_excerpt: **057. Fundamental groups of special complex varieties and root orbifolds.** Proves Campana's abelianity conjecture: special compact Kähler manifolds have virtually abelian fundamental groups. families.title: Semialgebraic universal covers and bounded domains.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the Kollár–Pardon conjecture: the universal cover of a connected normal projective complex variety is biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety if and only if it is a product of a bounded symmetric domain, a complex affine space, and a simply connected normal projective variety.

families.title: Counterexamples to Zariski’s multiplicity conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We give a negative answer to the embedded Zariski multiplicity conjecture. We construct two reduced hypersurface germs that are ambiently homeomorphic but have multiplicities two and three. families.title: The Global Spherical Shell conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the Global Spherical Shell conjecture: every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with positive second Betti number contains a global spherical shell. This is a holomorphically embedded neighborhood of the standard three-sphere in $`\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}`$ whose complement is connected.

families.title: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We resolve the contact-Fano homogeneity conjecture and the Riemannian LeBrun–Salamon conjecture positively. families.title: The generalized Mukai conjecture.
Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities.
Virasoro constraints for complete intersections and projective-bundle towers.
families.description_excerpt: **065. Virasoro constraints for complete intersections and projective-bundle towers.** Proves the full ordinary unreduced descendant Virasoro conjecture for smooth complete intersections in complex projective space, in every genus and curve class with arbitrary cohomology insertions. The constraints also pass from any smooth projective complex base

families.title: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions.
The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six.
families.description_excerpt: **067. The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six.** Proves the Campana–Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six: every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.

families.title: Anticanonical nonvanishing in every dimension.
families.description_excerpt: Every smooth connected projective complex variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle has a nonzero section of some positive anticanonical power.

families.title: Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level.
Koebe’s circle-domain conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that a circle domain with conformally removable boundary is conformally rigid, with no restriction on the number of complementary components. This establishes the removability-to-rigidity direction of the He–Schramm Conjecture.

families.title: Brennan's conjecture and the integral-means spectrum.
The Falconer distance conjecture.
Kakeya in three and four dimensions.
The $`L\log L`$ Fourier-convergence conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that the ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every complex-valued function in $`L\log L`$ on the circle converge almost everywhere to the function along the full sequence. This establishes the classical $`L\log L`$ sufficiency conjecture.

families.title: Real ultraflat Littlewood polynomials and unbounded binary merit factors.
Fourier restriction for positively curved surfaces.

families.title: The three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture in its strict-order formulation. The main result is boundedness of the Bochner–Riesz multipliers on $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ for every positive order. Interpolation and duality then give the full conjectured strict range.

families.title: Local smoothing in three dimensions.
The exact Sobolev endpoint for Schrödinger convergence.
Riesz transforms and rectifiability in higher codimension.
Annular variation and dyadic absolute bounds for the triangular Hilbert transform.
families.description_excerpt: We prove a uniform $`L^3\times L^3\times L^3`$ estimate for the dyadic triangular Hilbert form with unrestricted real inputs. families.title: Hilbert transforms along Lipschitz directions.
The geometric case of the Erdős similarity conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We construct a compact subset of the unit interval, of measure arbitrarily close to one, that contains no affine copy of the dyadic sequence $`\{2^{-n}:n\ge1\}`$. The conclusion holds for every translation and every nonzero real dilation, of either sign, proving the dyadic case of the Erdős similarity conjecture.

families.title: Endpoint Sobolev regularity of centered disk averages.
An L3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that the trilinear Hilbert transform with fixed slopes 1, 2, 3 maps $`L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)`$ to $`L^1(\mathbb R)`$, resolving this case of the trilinear Hilbert transform conjecture.

families.title: The Mahler conjectures, functional inequalities and polar-product symplectic width.
Sharp projection-body inequalities and a counterexample to simplex maximization.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that ellipsoids uniquely minimize the volume of the projection body among convex bodies of fixed volume in every dimension at least four. This proves Petty's projection-volume conjecture in these dimensions.

families.title: Bounded-distortion L1 embeddings of planar and bounded-treewidth graphs.
Triangular-lattice optimality, long-range Riesz and Coulomb energies, and spherical logarithmic energy.

families.title: Logarithmic and Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequalities and the B-conjecture.
The optimal order of convex-body covering density.
Dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures.
families.description_excerpt: **093. Dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures.** Proves a dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for centered log-concave densities with uniformly subgaussian linear marginals, with constant bounded by a universal multiple of the squared linear subgaussian parameter.

families.title: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp.
Hyperbolicity cones without semidefinite lifts.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that not every hyperbolicity cone is a spectrahedral shadow: some closed hyperbolicity cones admit no finite affine semidefinite lift, even with arbitrary real coefficients and any finite number of auxiliary variables. This disproves the Projected Lax Conjecture and hence the generalized Lax conjecture.

families.title: The Gaussian propeller conjecture in every dimension.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the Gaussian propeller conjecture: for every finite measurable partition of a Euclidean space, the sum of the squared lengths of its Gaussian first moments is at most $`9/(8\pi)`$. For dimension at least two and at least three cells, three planar sectors of angle $`2\pi/3`$, extended by an orthogonal Euclidean factor, attain the bound.

families.title: The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström bound.
Compact counterexamples to bi-Lipschitz dimension reduction.
families.description_excerpt: Every infinite-dimensional real Banach space contains a compact doubling subset that admits no bi-Lipschitz embedding into any finite-dimensional real normed space. The doubling constant has a universal bound, independent of the ambient Banach space. This answers the Lang–Plaut problem negatively, even for compact subsets of Hilbert space.

families.title: The sharp exponential scale of edit-distance distortion.
Cylinder coverings below the half-area bound.
families.description_excerpt: A regular tetrahedron admits a finite cylinder covering with compact triangular perpendicular bases whose total area is less than half its minimum orthogonal projection area. families.title: The sharp simplex conjecture for isotropic constants.
families.description_excerpt: **101. families.title: The Unique Games Conjecture and optimal approximation thresholds.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that approximating Max-Cut on simple unweighted graphs within any fixed factor greater than the Goemans–Williamson constant is NP-hard.

families.title: Exact derandomization of logarithmic space: $`\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}`$.
families.description_excerpt: We prove $`\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}`$, resolving the derandomization problem for polynomial-time randomized logarithmic space.

families.title: Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games.
Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games.
Hardness of coloring three-colorable graphs.
Matrix multiplication with exponent at most 9/4.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that the exponent of matrix multiplication over the complex numbers is at most 9/4.

families.title: A cubic permanent–determinant lower bound.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that the complex border determinantal complexity of the $`m\times m`$ permanent is $`\Omega(m^3)`$, allowing arbitrary affine-linear determinant representations and coefficientwise limits. families.title: Integer multiplication below $`n\log n`$.
Optimal-order randomized k-server on arbitrary metrics.
One-sample matroid prophet inequalities against an almighty adversary.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that one independent sample per element suffices for a constant-competitive prophet inequality on every finite matroid. families.title: Beyond the square-root exponent for depth-three circuits.
Approximate counting and entropy of perfect matchings.
Approximate counting of common integer polymatroid bases.

families.title: Sampling and counting contingency tables with arbitrary margins.
families.description_excerpt: We give an exact uniform sampler for nonnegative integer contingency tables with arbitrary prescribed margins. It terminates almost surely and has expected bit complexity polynomial in both dimensions and the binary length of the margins. No positivity, balance, sparsity, or fixed-dimension assumption is required.

families.title: Uniform black-box noncommutative identity testing across characteristics.
families.description_excerpt: We construct, in deterministic polynomial bit time, a polynomial-size list of rational matrix tuples for noncommutative rational formulas over ℚ of bounded tree size. families.title: Uniform sparsest cut: hardness and semidefinite gaps.

families.title: Bin packing and unbounded configuration-LP gaps.
The Courtade–Kumar and Hellinger conjectures.

families.title: Almost-linear-time exact matching and prescribed-degree factors in general graphs.
families.description_excerpt: **120. Almost-linear-time exact matching and prescribed-degree factors in general graphs.** Gives a randomized algorithm finding an exact maximum-cardinality matching in any simple undirected graph in $`(n+m)^{1+o(1)}`$ word time, with success probability at least 2/3. families.title: Almost-linear approximation of edit distance.
Quantitative trace-reconstruction bounds with a uniform decoder.
Polynomial-time scheduling on three identical machines.

Exponential semidefinite complexity of perfect matching.
Average sensitivity of polynomial threshold functions.
A factor-two approximation for shortest common superstring.

families.title: Rapid mixing of graph switches for every degree sequence.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the simple-undirected form of the Kannan–Tetali–Vempala conjecture: the switch chain on simple undirected graphs mixes in polynomial time for every graphical degree sequence. families.title: A superquadratic separation of sensitivity and block sensitivity.
The computational complexity of Weisfeiler–Leman refinement.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that deciding whether Weisfeiler–Leman refinement of an input dimension identifies a given graph is EXPTIME-complete. The input is a nonempty finite simple uncolored graph in adjacency-matrix form and a positive binary-encoded dimension. Identification quantifies over every comparison graph.

families.title: Generalized star height at most three.
families.description_excerpt: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has a generalized regular expression of star height at most thirteen over that same alphabet. We prove this uniform bound by representing finite monoid computations as affine updates and recovering them through twelve successive split constructions.

Subpolynomial query complexity for log-concave sampling.
Memory–sample lower bounds for noiseless Gaussian regression.

families.title: Deterministic polynomial factorization over prime fields.
Hilbert's sixteenth problem: uniform bounds for limit cycles.

families.title: Banach’s simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem.
Rokhlin’s multiple-mixing problem.
families.description_excerpt: Every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation is mixing of every finite order. Thus Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem for a single transformation has an affirmative answer.

families.title: Positive metric entropy for the standard map.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that the standard sine map of the two-dimensional torus has positive metric entropy with respect to normalized area for every sufficiently large positive parameter. This gives a full parameter tail, and hence answers Sinai's positive-parameter-measure conjecture affirmatively.

families.title: Classwise permanence for weakly reversible mass-action systems.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the permanence conjecture for finite weakly reversible mass-action systems with fixed positive reaction rates. Arithmetic classification and non-Pisot singularity for Bernoulli convolutions.

families.title: Pointwise multiple ergodic averages for mixing transformations.

families.title: A counterexample to periodic tiling in dimension three.
Borsuk's conjecture fails in dimension nine.
Graph coloring, clique minors, and Colin de Verdière invariants.

families.title: The Euclidean plane cannot be colored with five colors.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that every coloring of the Euclidean plane with five colors has a monochromatic unit-distance pair, with no regularity assumption on the color classes. Consequently, the chromatic number of the plane is either six or seven.

families.title: Erdős’s reciprocal-sum conjecture and quasipolynomial Szemerédi bounds.
Superexponential van der Waerden numbers.
Counterexamples to Sidorenko’s conjecture and the forcing conjecture.

families.title: Counterexamples to Ryser’s covering conjecture.
Hindman’s finite sums and products conjecture.

Hindman’s finite sums and products conjecture.** Proves Hindman's finite sums and products conjecture: every finite coloring of the positive integers contains sets of any prescribed finite size whose nonempty subset sums and nonempty subset products all have one common color.

families.title: The Harary–Hill and Zarankiewicz crossing-number formulas.

families.title: The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture.
Planar distinct distances and unit-distance bounds.
Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that an isomorphism of Bruhat intervals in arbitrary Coxeter systems preserves their equal-parameter Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials. This resolves the full combinatorial invariance conjecture positively.

families.title: Shareshian–Wachs elementary positivity.
Sharp logarithmic exponents for off-diagonal Ramsey numbers.

families.title: The hypercube Ramsey conjecture.
Classification of finite Euclidean Ramsey configurations.

families.title: Seymour’s second-neighborhood conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that every nonempty finite oriented graph has a vertex with at least as many vertices at directed distance two as at directed distance one. This resolves Seymour's second neighborhood conjecture positively.

families.title: Deterministic construction of strong thin spanning trees.
Talagrand’s expectation thresholds, discrete convexity, and graph decompositions.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the graph-decomposition conjecture of Ascoli, He, Park, and Talagrand. families.title: The second Kahn–Kalai conjecture with an edge-count bound.
Bounded-degree coboundary expanders.
Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree.
The circulant Hadamard and Barker-sequence conjectures.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the circulant Hadamard conjecture: a real circulant Hadamard matrix has order 1 or 4. As a consequence, Barker sequences of length greater than one exist exactly at lengths 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 13, proving the Barker-sequence conjecture.

families.title: Barnette’s Hamiltonian-cycle conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove Barnette's conjecture: every finite simple cubic bipartite planar 3-vertex-connected graph has a Hamiltonian cycle.

families.title: The Erdős–Gallai cycle-decomposition conjecture.
Power savings for intersective polynomial differences and prime arguments.
Power savings for planar halving lines and k-sets.

Counterexamples to infinite matroid intersection and packing/covering.

Snaky in 21 Maker moves.

The same bound holds on a $`17\times17`$ square; in fact, Maker can confine its claims to a fixed 251-cell board.

families.title: The sharp terminal leave in random triangle removal.
Cycle–clique Ramsey numbers.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that $`R(C_m,K_n)=(m-1)(n-1)+1`$ for every pair of integers $`m\ge n\ge3`$ other than $`(m,n)=(3,3)`$, for which $`R(C_3,K_3)=6`$. families.title: Polynomial removal fails for ordered binary matrices.
families.description_excerpt: We construct a fixed $`66\times66`$ binary matrix for which ordered matrix removal has no polynomial bound. This disproves the polynomial ordered binary matrix-removal conjecture. Ordered copies preserve the separate row and column orders and match both zeros and ones; removal permits changing entries in either direction.

families.title: A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound.
Boolean functions violate the square-root degree bound by arbitrary factors.
Serre’s intersection-multiplicity conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: **193. Serre’s intersection-multiplicity conjecture.** Proves strict positivity of Serre's intersection multiplicity $`\chi^R(M,N)`$ for nonzero finitely generated modules over any regular local ring, provided $`M\otimes_R N`$ has finite length and $`\dim M+\dim N=\dim R`$. families.title: Lech’s multiplicity conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove Lech's multiplicity conjecture: Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity cannot decrease under a flat local homomorphism of nonzero Noetherian local rings. The result holds in arbitrary dimension, with no restrictions on the residue fields or characteristics.

families.title: A counterexample to the small Cohen–Macaulay module conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We construct a three-dimensional complete Noetherian normal local domain containing ℂ, with residue field ℂ, that has no nonzero finitely generated maximal Cohen–Macaulay module. This disproves the domain form of the small Cohen–Macaulay module conjecture.

families.title: A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture.
A torsion-free group algebra that is not directly finite.
families.description_excerpt: We construct a finitely presented torsion-free counterexample to Kaplansky's direct finiteness conjecture over the field of two elements. The group admits a finite two-dimensional classifying complex.

families.title: A counterexample to finitistic-dimension finiteness.
families.description_excerpt: We construct a finite-dimensional complex algebra whose finite-dimensional modules have unbounded finite projective dimensions. This disproves the little finitistic-dimension conjecture.

families.title: Counterexamples to Auslander–Reiten, Tachikawa and related homological conjectures.
Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers.
families.description_excerpt: **200. Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers.** Proves the Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers conjectures over every characteristic-zero field. families.title: A counterexample to Kurosh’s division-ring problem.
families.description_excerpt: **201. A counterexample to Kurosh’s division-ring problem.** Constructs a countable characteristic-zero division ring that is algebraic over its center and generated by two elements over that center, but has infinite dimension over it. This answers Kurosh's division-ring problem on local finiteness negatively.

families.title: The blockwise Alperin weight conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: **202. The blockwise Alperin weight conjecture.** Proves the numerical blockwise Alperin weight conjecture for every prime and every finite group: the number of irreducible Brauer characters in a block equals the number of conjugacy classes of its weights.

families.title: Donovan's conjecture over fields and complete mixed-characteristic DVRs.
Tensor saturation for even spin groups.
Saxl’s conjecture and universal tensor squares.
families.description_excerpt: For every staircase partition, we prove that the tensor square of the corresponding irreducible complex representation of the symmetric group contains every irreducible representation of that group. This proves Saxl's conjecture.

families.title: Finite lattice representation and undecidability.
families.description_excerpt: We give an explicit colored-graph characterization of the finite nonempty lattices that occur as full congruence lattices of finite algebras, and prove that deciding this representation property is undecidable. families.title: The ℓ¹-Bass conjecture for all discrete groups.
Finite symmetric tensor categories and the Verlinde tower.
Integral counterexamples to Gersten’s conjecture.
Foulkes' conjecture for sixth powers and quadratic stabilization.
The geometric phase diagram, diffusion, and spectra of random planar maps.

families.title: Planar first-passage geometry and the absence of bigeodesics.

families.title: Critical percolation on every quasi-transitive graph.
families.description_excerpt: We prove that critical Bernoulli bond percolation has no infinite cluster on any infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph with critical probability less than one. This resolves the bond form of the criticality conjecture of Benjamini and Schramm.

families.title: The Benjamini–Schramm nonuniqueness conjecture.
families.description_excerpt: We prove the bond-percolation nonuniqueness conjecture of Benjamini and Schramm: every infinite connected, locally finite, nonamenable quasi-transitive graph has a nonempty interval of parameters for which Bernoulli bond percolation almost surely has infinitely many infinite clusters. families.title: Canonical $`O(3)`$ continuum limit and exact $`O(4)`$ mass asymptotics.

families.title: Perceptron free energies and microscopic jamming exponents.
families.description_excerpt: We determine the limiting free energy of the Ising perceptron with independent Gaussian patterns for every bounded Borel log-potential, at every fixed positive temperature and pattern density. families.title: Gaussian free field limits throughout the balanced six-vertex regime.

families.title: Shelah's eventual categoricity and the prescribed-threshold obstruction.

families.title: Rigidity of the Turing degrees.

families.description_excerpt: We prove that witnessed symmetric choice strictly increases the expressive power of choiceless polynomial time with counting. A fixed sentence with one witnessed-choice occurrence defines a Boolean query on every finite input that is not definable in the original counting formalism.

families.description_excerpt: We prove that a discrete group is amenable if and only if every uniformly bounded representation on a complex Hilbert space is similar to a unitary representation. This resolves Dixmier's unitarizability problem affirmatively for discrete groups.

families.description_excerpt: We construct a torsion-free word-hyperbolic group that is not residually finite, answering the residual-finiteness question for hyperbolic groups negatively.

families.description_excerpt: We construct an infinite finitely presented simple amenable group, giving a positive answer to the finite-presentation existence question for simple amenable groups.

families.title: Nonsingular systems of equations over arbitrary groups.
families.description_excerpt: Every finite nonsingular system of equations over an arbitrary group has a simultaneous solution in an overgroup. This proves Howie's conjecture on nonsingular systems.

families.title: A group without fixed price.
